messages:
amelia_csm: Heads-up — BluePeak onboarding hit a big cost spike during reindex last night. Theywant a concise QBR appendix + immediate mitigations before renewal talk next Monday.

raj_finops: Numbers from billing: 7d total $22,400 (typical weekly ~$3,800). Peak 2026-03-12 = $9,100. Route: `/v1/embeddings` using model "embed-large-open" ~68% of charge.

olivia_engineer: I dug into traces — an automated reindex retried 3x due to transient errors, each pass re-embedded ~180k docs. Batches of 1024, no client-side rate limiting.

tony_prod: Ops hypothesis: lack of idempotent resume + client retry caused duplicate embedding calls. Also they disabled prefix caching.

amelia_csm: Proposal for QBR appendix: 1) immediate safety credit + alert, 2) short-term: ingestion guardrails + limits, 3) mid-term: caching + dedupe, 4) long-term: dedicated embedding pool or scheduled quotas.

raj_finops: Draft quick numbers: safety buffer (1 wk) = $6,000; 2-week = $11,500. Dedicated embedding estimate (shared A10x) = $10,500/mo. Expected savings if caching/batching fixed ~35-45%.

olivia_engineer: Quick ops playbook to include in appendix:
```
- Immediate: apply spending alert for BluePeak when 24h_spend > $5k -> notify cs + finops
- Short-term: set route throttle to 3 rps and max_batch=256
- Short-term: enable idempotency token check on ingest-worker
- Mid-term: enable KV prefix caching and de-duplication pass before embed job
- Escalation: if spend > $7k/day for >48h -> migrate to dedicated embedding pool proposal
```

tony_prod: Also add a customer-facing statement: "we'll provide a temporary credit and a one-hour enablement to walk through safe reindex steps."

amelia_csm: Action owners
- raj_finops: prepare credit figure + PO template (EOD)
- olivia_engineer: push alert rule + throttle on route (2pm)
- tony_prod: draft one-paragraph customer note and QBR appendix slide (by Fri)
- amelia_csm: schedule 20m pre-QBR sync with customer (tomorrow)

olivia_engineer: I'll create alert: `alert: customer_bluepeak_embeddings_24h > 5000` -> notify cs, finops; and add a mute rule to avoid noisy retries. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-guardrails

raj_finops: I'll include example table for slide: 
`Safety buffer (1wk) - $6,000; Dedicated pool - $10,500/mo; Est. burn reduction w/ fixes - 40%`

amelia_csm: Who from renewals should be looped? cc renewals@redwood and include SLA fallback + renewal play.

ton...`qbr-bot`: created summary for thread 1768136000. Assignments recorded: raj_finops (credit), olivia_engineer (alerts/throttle), tony_prod (slide + note), amelia_csm (customer sync). Next checkpoint 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC.

amelia_csm: Thanks all — please drop updates in thread when done. :sparkles:
